exact_divisibility_basis: For distinct true nodes xi<1, Hermite H satisfies H(xi)=fi,Hprime(xi)=fi^3 and (2-2xi)fi^2=1. Thus G(xi)=Gprime(xi)=0 exactly. Pairwise coprime factors (t-xi)^2 divide G in the real coefficient field; monic product W divides G, quotient degree<=27. Interval remainder zero containment is only a consistency diagnostic, never the exactness proof.
minorant_implication: W>=0 and Q>=0 yield 1-(2-2t)H^2>=0 on domain. Since 2-2t>0, |H|sqrt(2-2t)<=1, hence H<=1/sqrt(2-2t); no H>=0 premise.
scope: Only algebraic Hermite minorant; does not certify R_H positivity, contacts, PSD or Thomson optimality.
